name: harz-universal-app-contract-v1-20261008
description: HARZ-wide rule issued by Rabiu Oct 8 2026: the HARZ Universal App Contract — one app, one interface, online when connected, offline when disconnected, no blank screen, offline is honest (LIVE/CACHED/OFFLINE/STALE labels), automatic recovery, and the 6-step death test. Canonical text stored here. Strategy: audit existing apps against it, no blind rebuilds.
content:
{
  "name": "HARZ Universal App Contract v1",
  "issued": "2026-10-08 by Rabiu, HARZ-wide rule",
  "creed": "One app. One interface. Online when connected. Offline when disconnected. No blank screen, no dependency failure, and no pretending that live data exists when it doesn't.",
  "clauses": {
    "1_app_shell_is_local": "HTML/CSS/JS/assets are available on the device. The app can open with zero internet.",
    "2_local_state_is_durable": "Important records are stored locally. Closing the app, losing power, or losing network must not erase the user's work.",
    "3_online_is_an_enhancement": "When internet exists, the app can synchronize, fetch fresh data, or use network services. Internet must never be required just to open the application.",
    "4_offline_is_honest": "LIVE = verified from the network. CACHED = previously obtained and stored locally. OFFLINE = local functionality with no current network verification. STALE = data exists but its freshness cannot be guaranteed. Never display cached information as live.",
    "5_automatic_recovery": "Network disappears -> continue offline. Network returns -> synchronize/reconcile. Failed synchronization remains visible rather than silently disappearing.",
    "6_death_test": "Internet ON -> open -> use -> internet OFF -> close -> reopen -> continue -> internet ON -> synchronize -> verify. Every important app should pass."
  },
  "strategy": "Audit the existing apps against the contract rather than rebuilding everything blindly.",
  "enforcement": "All new builds must comply (extends BUILD PROTOCOL v2 PWA check). Existing fleet: phased audit \u2014 Phase 1 automated presence screening (manifest, service worker, install tags, shell cached locally), Phase 2 real-browser death tests per VERIFICATION PROTOCOL."
}
